parity_candidates.claim: No landing, password recovery, profile edit, donation, wishlist item, or checkout route appears in the local route map.
Registration is locked to synthetic identity and three fixture school rows.
Approval is simulated; login is a passwordless demo toggle.
Profile creation is one-time and offers only a bio plus inert wishlist URL.
Teacher directory contains two seeds plus same-tab-created profiles, with no declared remote search/filter/pagination.
HTTP provider sends no network requests; backend-dependent UI states require local mocks/fixtures for comparison.
No local font file found; image set is small and includes a used apple placeholder.
Not-found and failure/retry states exist in source, but browser rendering/accessibility/responsive behavior were not tested.

reference_comparison: Six live marketing routes and local initial pages plus fixture journey are captured desktop/mobile. Additional read-only evidence covers login/reset shells, Teacher of the Day profile, mobile menu, terms dialog, contact character count, and integrated PageRouter route. No production submit/auth/donation/contact send.
